apps.name: CourtPredict
apps.subtitle: Predict basketball game winners and compete with friends! Track your accuracy and climb the leaderboard based on your winning percentage.
apps.localizedDescription:
CourtPredict turns every basketball game into a friendly competition!

Predict the winner of each matchup and see how your predictions stack up against your friends and the community. The leaderboard is based on your winning percentage, accuracy is all that matters!

Features:
• Predict basketball game winners each day
• Compete with friends in private or public groups
• Follow your prediction stats and winning percentage
• Real-time game results and automatic updates
• Clean, modern, and easy-to-use design

No betting, no money — just pure basketball knowledge and friendly competition.
This app is not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by the NBA or any of its teams.

Think you know basketball? Prove it with CourtPredict!
